reviews.title: Excellent RAM Memory
reviews.comment: I went with this RAM memory for a new build, and it has been a game-changer. Here's why this product deserves a five-star rating: Performance: The boost in performance was immediately noticeable. My computer now runs much faster and handles multitasking with ease. Applications open instantly, and I can run multiple programs simultaneously without any lag. The overall system responsiveness has greatly improved, making my workflow smoother and more efficient. Build Quality: The build quality of this RAM module is top-notch. The heat spreader is well-designed and ensures that the RAM stays cool even under heavy load. The materials used feel premium, and the module fits perfectly into the DIMM slots without any issues. Ease of Installation: Installing this RAM was a breeze. It came with clear instructions, and the installation process was straightforward. The module clicked into place easily, and my system recognized it immediately without any compatibility issues. Compatibility: I tested this RAM with various motherboards and processors, and it worked flawlessly with all of them. It's compatible with both Intel and AMD systems, providing flexibility for different builds. The plug-and-play nature of the RAM makes it an excellent choice for both novice and experienced builders. Value for Money: Given the significant performance improvement, this RAM offers excellent value for money. It’s a small investment that makes a big difference in daily computing tasks, gaming, and professional workloads. The increase in system speed and stability is well worth the price. Aesthetics: The sleek design of the RAM module adds a touch of elegance to my build. If you have a windowed case, the RAM looks fantastic and complements other components nicely. The option for RGB lighting is a bonus, allowing for further customization of the setup. Overall, this RAM memory is a stellar upgrade for anyone looking to boost their system’s performance. It combines excellent build quality, ease of installation, and noticeable performance gains, making it a five-star product in every aspect!
reviews.author: Rodendo

reviews.title: Good looks, good quality, good performance.
reviews.comment: Performance is solid so far after several months. I have this RAM paired with a Gigabyte X870E Auros Pro Ice motherboard, AMD 9800X3D CPU, Zotac RTX 5080 Solid OC GPU, Thermalright Rainbow Vision 360 AIO and Lian Li EDGE 1220W PSU. All white edition hardware installed in a Lian Li SUP 01-45L case. The aesthetic and quality is top notch and both looks good and performs well, despite the bargain price. With EXPO enabled it's running 6,000Mhz (DRAM frequency ~2994Mhz) at CL 30-36-36-76. Games and everything else running buttery smooth. I was not familiar with this brand of memory prior to this purchase. I did some research and KLEVV appears to be South Korean branding that is less known in the U.S. Apparently it's a brand connected to SK.Hynix in the same way that Crucial is related to Micron. So it's from a solid manufacturer with a solid reputation. Knowing this and after installing and using the memory myself, I can definitely recommend it. There doesn't seem to be anything about this memory kit that is inferior to more expensive options. Save a few bucks and go for it.
reviews.author: Gary M. SEI

reviews.title: Fast, stable, and efficient… all while looking clean and classy with RGB to boot
reviews.comment: This set of ram is fantastic. They look very clean and classy, nice design and rgb capable. Have both XMP and EXPO profiles. Paired it with my Gigabyte x670e Aorus Pro X with a 7800X3D. Even though it was not on the motherboard QVL, applied EXPO settings in BIOS and booted up without any issues. 64GB is more than enough, 6000MTs CL30 is perfect for the Ryzen, won’t overload the IMC so you will have no problems with post, boot, or stability. This fixed my micro stutters I was getting while gaming with my previous ram that I thought was faster (7600MTs) and on the motherboard QVL. Unless you’re building a pure benchmarking rig, it’s not always about speed, but what your particular hardware ecosystem can work with efficiently.
reviews.author: Jason L

reviews.title: Great RAM for AMD AM5 Platform.
reviews.comment: Pros, 1. Worked with my Ryzen 7 9800X3D on an MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK MAX WIFI motherboard. 2. 2x32gb of RAM course. Plenty of RAM for multitasking, content creation, video editing and LLMs. 3. Has good heatsinks on the memory modules. 4. Includes ARGB lighting(look under cons as well). 5. I got this RAM at a good price. Cons, 1. The ARGB lighting may vary depending on your motherboard. It's  controllable on my MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK MAX WIFI motherboard and it has claims for a lot of other motherboards, I'd look under your motherboard specs before buying this RSM if ARGB is important to you. 2. Even though this may be EXPO and XMP compatible I'd  still look under your motherboards QVL to see if it going to work and update your bios for better compatible. 3. The memory training time is slow(at least on the AM5 platform). Looking at current memory DDR5 prices I'm extremely happy I got this memory before it got more expensive. That was lucky on my part.
reviews.author: Steven Tarren

reviews.title: Great Quality, Lights, and Company Support
reviews.comment: Great ram, works well. The brightness of the rgb lights was stronger than I expected. That's good if you care about that rgb stuff because the lights look pretty. If not you can always turn off the lights in the bios settings or software either way so you're fine. KLEVV company is great, if you have any problem they will help you which is very nice.
reviews.author: Online Consumer
